'''2009 Bespin Regionals Peter Fratjord LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Fratjord]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Peter Fafjord
* '''Deck name:''' Do Jedi Dream Of Electric Sheep?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
